caption: The drawing depicts a single closed chest placed against a plain, light background. The chest has a domed lid and is constructed from brown material that appears textured, resembling animal hide or leather. The chest features two long, curved leather straps running across the top and metal studs or rivets securing them. There is a metal handle at the top center of the lid. The front of the chest has vertical leather strips also fastened with metal rivets, and a central metal plate, which is rectangular and dark in color, with a keyhole and a large, downward-hanging latch attached. The overall color palette includes various shades of brown and tan, with greenish undertones on the metal rivets and handle. The surface of the chest shows shading to indicate curvature and texture, suggesting three-dimensionality. There are no other visible objects or elements within the composition.
title: Miniature Chest
